# Third-party art (CC0)

Reusable assets with permissive licenses. Document source in each pack README.

| Vendor | Folder | Notes |
|--------|--------|--------|
| [Kenney](https://kenney.nl) | `Kenney/` | 2D icons/items — see `Kenney/README.md` |
| [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org) | `OpenGameArt/` | 3D models — see pack README |

Playground **trees** are built from Unity primitives in the scene; **creatures and props** use imported FBX under `Art/ThirdParty/` (same idea: visible 3D mesh in the world, not sprites).

HUD wood icon: `Assets/Art/Icons/HUD/` (not ThirdParty).
